title: Sprint 3 – Authentication, Authorization & Security
description: Sprint Goal: Secure the application by fixing authentication, permissions, and common security vulnerabilities.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 – Repair Authentication System
tickets.description:
Users experience login failures due to authentication issues.

Expected Work
Fix login functionality.
Verify JWT authentication.
Ensure authenticated users receive valid tokens.
Validate protected endpoints.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 – Fix Authorization Bugs
tickets.description:
Users can access APIs that should be restricted based on their roles.

Expected Work
Review permission classes.
Restrict unauthorized access.
Verify role-based permissions.
Test multiple user roles.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 – Prevent Unauthorized Data Modification
tickets.description:
Users can update fields that should never be editable.

Expected Work
Restrict serializer fields.
Protect system-managed fields.
Prevent privilege escalation.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 3 – Prevent Unauthorized Data Modification

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 3 – Prevent Unauthorized Data Modification

tickets.title: Ticket 4 – Secure File Upload APIs
tickets.description:
The application allows users to upload any type of file without validation.

Expected Work
Validate file types.
Restrict unsupported extensions.
Validate file size.
Handle invalid uploads safely.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 4 – Secure File Upload APIs

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 4 – Secure File Upload APIs

tickets.title: Ticket 5 – Fix Password Reset Flow
tickets.description:
Password reset functionality contains multiple security flaws.

Expected Work
Validate reset tokens.
Handle expired tokens.
Prevent reuse of old tokens.
Ensure secure password updates.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 5 – Fix Password Reset Flow

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 5 – Fix Password Reset Flow

tickets.title: Ticket 6 – Implement API Rate Limiting
tickets.description:
Authentication endpoints are vulnerable to brute-force attacks because request throttling is missing.

Expected Work
Configure API throttling.
Apply rate limits.
Verify throttling behavior.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 6 – Implement API Rate Limiting

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 6 – Implement API Rate Limiting

tickets.title: Ticket 7 – Remove Sensitive Information from APIs
tickets.description:
Several APIs expose confidential information in responses.

Expected Work
Remove sensitive fields.
Hide internal implementation details.
Ensure only required data is returned.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 7 – Remove Sensitive Information from APIs

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 7 – Remove Sensitive Information from APIs
